title: Late Fee Schedule for Pocketwire Pay in 4 Installments
content:
| Tier | Late fee per late installment (USD) | Grace period after the due date (calendar days) | Late fees per installment, at most | Cap on all late fees of one plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 7.00 | 1 | 1 | 25.00 percent of the purchase amount |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 7.00 | 1 | 1 | 25.00 percent of the purchase amount |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 7.00 | 2 | 1 | 25.00 percent of the purchase amount |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 5.00 | 2 | 1 | 20.00 percent of the purchase amount |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 5.00 | 3 | 1 | 15.00 percent of the purchase amount |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 0.00 | 3 | 1 | 10.00 percent of the purchase amount |

The Pocketwire Pay in 4 late fee schedule above applies to an account according to the tier it is on.

### Clauses

**1. When a late fee is charged.** An installment still unpaid when the tier's grace period of calendar days has passed after its due date is charged the tier's late fee, booked on that installment.

**2. One fee per installment.** An installment is charged at most one late fee.

**3. Plan cap.** A late fee is charged only while the plan's late fees, that fee included, stay within the tier's cap, taken as a percentage of that plan's purchase amount. A fee is charged at the tier's full late fee amount; a fee that would take the plan's late fees above the cap is not charged.

**4. Past due.** An installment still unpaid after its grace period makes the account past due. This follows from the installment being unpaid, whether or not a fee is charged on it, and on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite, whose late fee is USD 0.00, no fee is charged.

**5. Paused installments.** A paused installment, whether paused by a dispute or by hardship, is never late while the pause lasts.

### Grace period, day by day (hypothetical installment due on day 14)

| Tier | Paid on day | Late? |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic (1 grace day) | 14 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic (1 grace day) | still unpaid on day 15 | Yes — fee charged and account past due |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select (2 grace days) | 15 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select (2 grace days) | still unpaid on day 16 | Yes — fee charged and account past due |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier (3 grace days) | still unpaid on day 17 | Yes — fee charged and account past due |

### Cap, worked (hypothetical plans)

- **Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter, purchase USD 60.00.** The cap is 25.00 percent of USD 60.00, that is USD 15.00. If installments 2, 3 and 4 each pass their grace period unpaid, the first late fee of USD 7.00 is charged (late fees USD 7.00), the second is charged (USD 14.00, within the cap), and the third is not charged, because USD 21.00 would exceed USD 15.00. All three late installments still make the account past due.
- **Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier, purchase USD 100.00.** The cap is 15.00 percent, that is USD 15.00. Three late fees of USD 5.00 reach exactly USD 15.00, which stays within the cap, so all three are charged.

### Points of judgement

- The grace period runs in calendar days from the installment's own due date, and the fee sits on that installment of that plan.
- Each late fee is added to what the customer owes on Pocketwire Pay in 4.
